messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: Error in methRead - length of 'location' and 'name' should be same
parts:
Hello Uma,

there is a problem in the way you set up the list of files. As you see from your last output of:

> file.list
[[...]]


You get four different files from the list, but you have an additional  

$package


[1] "methylKit"


contained in the list. This is causing the error because your file.list is of length 5, even though you only have 4 names. 

Remove the 

package ="methylKit"

from the file.list and you are ready to go!

Best, 

Alex
